description.zh: 为高频操作提供可发现的键盘加速键，并配帮助入口。提示可用工具条标注、快捷键对话框（⌘K 风格）或 vim 式序列。它服务专家用户提速，同时必须保证焦点可见、不抢夺输入框按键，新手也能查到怎么按。
description.en: Discoverable keyboard accelerators for frequent commands, paired with a help entry. Hints can live in tooltips, a shortcuts dialog (⌘K-style) or vim-like sequences. It speeds up experts while keeping focus visible, never stealing keys from text inputs, and staying discoverable for newcomers.

use_when.zh: 高频重复操作密集（编辑器、后台、设计工具）
use_when.en: Dense, repetitive commands — editors, admin tools, design apps

use_when.zh: 用户以键盘流为主，追求肌肉记忆
已有命令面板，需要补齐按键绑定与帮助
use_when.en: A command palette exists and needs key bindings plus help

avoid_when.zh: 表单输入为主的页面，全局劫持按键会毁掉打字
avoid_when.en: Form-heavy pages where global key capture breaks typing

avoid_when.zh: 触屏为主的产品，快捷键无处施展
avoid_when.en: Touch-first products with no keyboard to accelerate

avoid_when.zh: 只给快捷键不给可发现入口，新手完全摸不到
avoid_when.en: Shortcuts with no discoverability path — newcomers are stuck

note.zh: 按钮旁或悬浮提示里标注按键，最轻量
note.en: Key chips beside buttons or in tooltips — lightest touch

note.zh: ⌘K 或 ? 唤出全量速查表
note.en: ⌘K or ? opens a full cheat sheet

note.zh: 多键序列（gg、dd），专家效率极高但学习成本大
note.en: Multi-key sequences (gg, dd) — steep, but blazing for experts

notes.zh: 监听 keydown 时检查 event.target：处于 input / textarea / contenteditable 内则跳过单键 绑定。用 event.key + metaKey/ctrlKey/shiftKey 组合判定，调用 preventDefault 前确认不会 破坏系统或浏览器保留键。快捷键对话框可 role="dialog"，kbd 元素展示按键。焦点环用 :focus-visible，尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。
notes.en: On keydown inspect event.target — skip single-key bindings when focus sits in input, textarea or contenteditable. Match on event.key plus metaKey/ctrlKey/shiftKey and only preventDefault when the combination is not reserved by the OS or browser. The shortcuts dialog can be role="dialog" with kbd elements showing keys. Style focus with :focus-visible and respect prefers-reduced-motion.

basic.zh: 创建一个快捷键（Keyboard Shortcuts）演示：按钮可点，也能用按键触发，并提供速查帮助。
basic.en: Create a keyboard-shortcuts demo: buttons respond to clicks and keys, with a cheat-sheet help entry.

design.zh: 创建快捷键演示。要求：工具条按钮旁标注 ⌘K / ⌘S 等按键；按 ? 唤出快捷键速查对话框，列出分组绑定；实际按键可触发对应操作并给反馈；焦点环清晰；支持深浅色主题。
design.en: Create a shortcuts demo. Requirements: key chips such as ⌘K / ⌘S beside toolbar buttons; ? opens a grouped cheat-sheet dialog; real key presses trigger the actions with feedback; clear focus rings; light and dark themes.

implementation.zh: 用 React + window keydown 实现：useEffect 绑定/解绑监听，检查 event.target 是否在输入控件内； 绑定表数据驱动（{keys, label, run}）。对话框 Esc 关闭并归还焦点。按键展示用 kbd 元素。 动画时长乘 var(--demo-speed, 1)，尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。
implementation.en: Implement with React + window keydown: bind/unbind in useEffect and skip when event.target is an input control; drive bindings from data ({keys, label, run}). Close the dialog on Esc and return focus. Render keys with kbd. Scale animation durations by var(--demo-speed, 1) and respect prefers-reduced-motion.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现快捷键体系。

先检查现有组件体系和 Design Token，优先复用当前组件。
保持现有项目视觉风格。不要新增不必要依赖。
要求：
- 高频操作有按键绑定，并在 UI 上可发现
- 提供快捷键帮助对话框或速查入口
- 不抢夺输入框按键，焦点环使用 :focus-visible
- 尊重 prefers-reduced-motion
完成后运行项目现有检查，并列出修改的文件。
agent.en:
Implement a keyboard shortcut system in the current project.

Inspect the existing component system and design tokens first; reuse existing components.
Keep the project's visual style. Add no unnecessary dependencies.
Requirements:
- Key bindings for frequent commands, discoverable in the UI
- A shortcuts help dialog or cheat-sheet entry
- Never steal keys from text inputs; focus rings via :focus-visible
- Respect prefers-reduced-motion
Run existing project checks when done and list the modified files.
